summary_en: Mitsubishi Corporation authorized the acquisition of up to 420 million shares (approximately 6% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) for up to 1 trillion yen through market purchase from November 5, 2026 to July 31, 2027, followed by cancellation of all acquired shares on August 31, 2027, to enhance capital efficiency under the Medium-Term Management Strategy 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding the Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Mitsubishi Corporation's Board of Directors has authorized the acquisition of treasury stock up to a maximum of 420 million shares for a total of up to 1 trillion yen. Based on the November 2, 2026 closing price, this quantity represents approximately 6% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock. The acquisition will be executed through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 5, 2026 and July 31, 2027. All acquired shares will be cancelled as of August 31, 2027.

The company stated that this capital return policy is aligned with its Medium-Term Management Strategy 2027 and the shareholder return and cash allocation framework disclosed in its second quarter earnings announcement for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The acquisition is designed to enhance capital efficiency while the company maintains financial soundness and continues disciplined investment in growth strategies.

As of September 30, 2026, the company held 47.17 million treasury shares against 3.66 billion shares outstanding excluding treasury stock. The cancellation of all acquired shares would further reduce the share count and improve per-share metrics for remaining shareholders.
